rate_limits.summary: SCAPI load shedding and rate limiting is documented. Per search snippets: SLAS about 24,000 req/min per tenant in production and 500 in non-production. Over-limit requests get HTTP 429. Overloaded systems return 503. Unverified against the page text.

The SDK is generated from the SCAPI OAS specs that the ECOM monorepo publishes.
